text:
Alex: Quick flag — ran a region-cost sim for Q2 capacity and the delta is weird. APAC H100 reserved shows ~28% lower GPU-unit price but projected network/egress pushes overall TCO above us-west.
Mira: Can you paste the sim output? Which APAC region? seoul/sng?
Alex: se-sg and ap-northeast-1. Short excerpt:
```
$ python cost_sim.py --region ap-northeast-1 --gpu H100 --tier prod --hours 720
gpu_cost: $46,200
egress_est: $12,900
replication_net: $7,100
total: $66,200
```
Sam: Oof replication_net looks high — what caused that? cross-zone copies? model sharding?
Alex: It's mostly model shard sync across replica groups and our KV cache invalidation pattern, combined with inter-region backups to EU for compliance snapshots.
Priya: Are we double-charging due to VPC egress vs private peering? Billing bot had an alert last night about unexpected inter-region transfer in ap-northeast-1.
billing-bot: ALERT: Unusual egress spike detected in ap-northeast-1 between 03:00-04:00 UTC. Estimated extra cost: $4,200. Trigger: replication-sync.
Dan: We should check the overlay network config — last change rolled out a new shard-replica topology (PR #4812). That might have increased cross-AZ traffic.
Mira: If we can avoid cross-region backups for the hot KV (keep hot replicas local + async cold backups) we can shave that replication_net number a lot.
Sam: Also compare preemptible/spot eviction risk. APAC spots have higher preempt rates based on last 30d, which will increase effective reserved needs for SLOs.
Alex: Right — my sim assumed stable reserved usage. If we model 8% eviction overhead we lose that 28% savings.
Priya: Proposal: run a quick A/B: move one small ppool to ap-northeast-1 with loc-only KV caching and no cross-region backups for 2 weeks. Monitor egress/billing.
Dan: +1. Also add a temporary VPC peering test to see if private links cut egress costs (hypothesis: saves ~60% on transfer).
Mira: Which metrics should we watch? I'd say: token latency p95, egress bytes by flow, preemption count, and cost per effective token.
Sam: I'll wire up a dashboard for that and a billing alarm for transfer > $1k/day. ETA today.
Alex: Cool. If APAC still wins after these mitigations, we can submit a reserved commitment for a small tranche to test pricing at scale.
Priya: Also let's add a quick accounting note: when committing, make sure to model sustained usage + 10% headroom for failover.
Dan: I'll open a short runbook for the ppool swap and assign owners.
Alex: Thanks everyone — will post the sim configs and PR links in the thread.
